stories.title: Gazprom, Iran discuss potential cooperation in gas sector
stories.summary: According to the Russian holding, CEO Alexey Miller had a meeting with Iranian Ambassador to Russia Kazem Jalali and NIGC CEO Saeed Tavakoli
article_sentences: Gazprom CEO Alexey Miller has held a working meeting with Iran’s Ambassador to Russia Kazem Jalali and CEO of the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) Saeed Tavakoli, the Russian holding reported.
"The parties discussed potential cooperation in the gas sector," the report said.
Previously, Gazprom reported on gas negotiations with representatives from Iran in September 2025.
